title: Evaluating AI Counseling in Japanese: Counselor, Client, and Evaluator Roles Assessed by Motivational Interviewing Criteria
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the performance of LLMs in Japanese-language counseling roles based on the Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) coding system. While it contains a brief mandatory section on 'Ethical Considerations' regarding the lack of human participant data, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, theology, faith, or moral/ethical frameworks as a primary study component.
